correctness.rationale: Modulo gcd(n,h), b is the identity and a is a common translation, so distinct residue classes cannot merge. When coprime, the +h cyclic order makes 0 the predecessor of h. For any proper nonempty interval, inverse b adds 0 at the left only if the old left endpoint is h, deletes only a right endpoint if it shrinks, and otherwise leaves the interval fixed. Empty preimages cannot subsequently become full; after the first full preimage it remains full, so use only the prefix of the reverse scan through first attainment. Each of the at least n-1 growth steps adds one point; between two such steps the left endpoint must move from 0 to h by decrements of one and non-growing b steps cannot help. The n-2 gaps thus cost at least n-h rotations each. Starting from {h}, inverse b gives {0,h}; shifting by h via inverse a^(n-h) and applying inverse b extends the successive intervals through all of Q. The bound and word coincide, including n=2, with no rotations between growth steps.
residual_risks: The reproduction is bounded to n<=12; the formula for larger n rests on the interval argument. The frozen verifier's other reported checks were not independently rerun.
